description: Rental Report, VIC is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by VIC Department of Families, Fairness and Housing (DFFH). A rental report and corresponding data providing key statistics on the private rental market in Victoria, produced by the VIC Department of Families, Fairness and Housing. Coverage is the states and territories, 2000 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-27. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
